summary: Stabilize offline voice cancellation feedback and guard Send-only delivery.

changes.title: Give every explicit offline voice cancellation the correct haptic
changes.detail: Fire the existing important-action, DND-aware confirmation from the private voice session exit for Cancel label, microphone, drag-and-release and TalkBack actions. Normal Stop, completion, editor loss and microphone errors never trigger this discard haptic; remove the duplicate ordinary key-tick from the offline Cancel label.

changes.title: Guard hold-to-talk auto-send with one tested policy
changes.detail: Dispatch Send only for an explicitly enabled hold-to-talk result in the unchanged editor and an IME_ACTION_SEND field, never when private mode is active. Add focused regressions for Send, Go, Done, Search, private mode, no request, and changed editor destination. Preserve continuous live batches, models, signing and data.
